profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at P2 Energy Solutions
profile.summary:
Seasoned professional with high level of expertise in software development, project management, and IT management. Recent software development experience include developing enterprise class ERP solutions and related tools for the Construction, and Oil & Gas industries.

Proficiency in various programming languages and technologies including:
C#, SQL, Visual Studio, Entity Framework, Team Foundation, Visual Basic, (SAFe) Agile Methodology, Domain Driven Design concepts, Restful Web Service, Unit Testing, etc.

Also extensive experience with Rocket U2 Multi-Value technologies, such as UniVerse, UniData, SB+, and SB/XA.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Developing world-class upstream oil and gas software solutions.

positions.title: Software Development - Team Lead
positions.description:
Served as Software Developer for developing and maintaining modern ERP solution, utilizing latest Microsoft development platform, tools and technologies, including Visual Studio, C#, SQL Server, Team Foundation, Entity Framework, etc.

Served as Team Lead for supporting a legacy ERP product, which was in the process of being migrated to a more modern ERP solution.  Duties included supervising software developers, coordinating team meetings, supporting internal Support and Professional Services staff, performing customer billable projects, and interacting with customers directly as needed.  Also performed systems and database administration duties, as needed.

positions.title: Technical Project Manager/Software Developer - Internet Team
positions.description:
Managed development projects for a Web Application Development (Internet) Team.  Also performed software development duties as a member of the team.  

Served as a liaison between business analysts, software/web developers and end-users to define and develop technical specifications and business rules for development projects.

Developed various web applications for the Student Loan industry, utilizing Microsoft technologies to include Visual Basic, SQL Server, ASP, HTML, CSS.  For example, one web application was developed to interface with major credit reporting agencies as required by defined student loan application process.

positions.title: Manager of IS/IT Department
positions.description:
Served as Manager of the IS/IT department which included supervising software developers, network engineer, hardware and software support staff.  Communicated and worked with 3rd party vendors, and external agencies such as hospitals, payors, other provider groups, etc.on behalf of our organization.

Also performed software development duties as needed for an internally developed software solution.

positions.title: Software Developer/Systems Analyst
positions.description: Performed various duties including software development for an internally developed solution for managing a preferred provider network (PPO), systems and database administration, researching and recommending external solutions, end-user support and training, etc.
